uv_convention: u = x / size, v = 1 - y / size (glTF v is top-down: use 1 - v there); a named cell's uv is its centre
colour_space: PNG holds sRGB; rgb_linear is the material value the style guide used (Blender/glTF linear)
rules: existing pixels never move or change
new named colours only in free cells
one colour per face: collapse the face's UVs to a point inside one section, a few pixels from any edge

a section's masks define its surface: the emission image's alpha is strength / 4 (GLOW sections only); the surface image's R is metallic and G gloss where A is set (SATIN and POLISHED only); everything else is matte
every section holds the whole colour space: pick the same spot in another section for the same colour on another surface
